action_args.justification: The series is dominated by a very strong upward trend (slope agreement 0.994) and strong weekly seasonality (period 52, strength 0.64). The redundant-error groups (DWT_rf/FT_rf, CWT_rf/ONLY_DWT_rf) further argue against aggressive weighting that would chase 3 windows of noise.
